design: Single prespecified interaction, no threshold search. Fixed-time prior-only rolling quartiles. Price response uses flow-oriented 10s midpoint displacement in spread units divided by max(0.25, absolute rolling 10s flow ratio); 15s displacement describes maturity. ORIGINAL: above-median participation and depth-update activity, range expansion, upper-quartile positive efficiency, moving but not mature displacement, stable spread. REVERSED: upper-quartile flow, lower-quartile and declining efficiency under sustained same-side pressure, mature aligned displacement, activity deceleration and range contraction, non-improving spread within liquidity cap. Otherwise NO_TRADE. Missing, stale or degenerate history abstains. Epoch changes invalidate state history and pending fills.
